subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: robinson crusoe was born in england right from his boyhood he wanted to be a sailor but his father did not like the idea at all he wanted that he should study law robinson was determined to pursue his career Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Robinson Crusoe was born in England. Right from his boyhood, he wanted to be a sailor. But his father did not like the idea at all. He wanted that he should study law. Robinson was determined to pursue his career. ● Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
